Metadata.title: AboutSelphy — streamer & creator
Metadata.description: AboutSelphy is a streamer and content creator. Find out who I am, what I stream, when I'm live, and how brands can work with me.

overview.intro: This is where the website's content gets managed. Sections switch on here as they're built.

sections.about: Edit the About text and bio, in German and English.
sections.schedule: Weekly and one-time streams, categories and cancellations.
sections.partners: Manage past partners, brand deals and sponsor packages for the media kit.
sections.inquiries: Read and answer sponsor inquiries sent through the media kit.
sections.stats: Check when the YouTube and Twitch numbers were last synced.
sections.games: Add games, set their status and order for “What I play”.
sections.legal: Legal notice and privacy policy for the public site.

about.intro: The text on the home page. English and German are edited side by side; both are required.
about.adminOnly: Only admins can edit the profile. Ask the owner if something needs to change.
about.taglineHint: One sentence under your name. Also used for search results.
about.bioHint: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs.
about.saved: Profile saved. The home page shows the new text now.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can save the profile.
errors.invalid: Some fields aren't valid. Check the marked fields.
errors.failed: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.

stats.intro: The numbers behind the media kit. A sync runs every 5 minutes; slow-moving numbers are refreshed hourly.
stats.syncedWithErrors: Sync finished with errors. See the latest run below.
stats.syncForbidden: You need to be signed in as staff.
stats.noData: No data yet. Run a sync.
stats.twitchNote: Twitch has no API for average viewers, so these come from our own samples every 5 minutes while live.
stats.noStreams: No streams sampled yet. Numbers appear after the next stream.

youtube.heading: YouTube Analytics
youtube.intro: Audience demographics (age, gender, countries, devices) for the media kit. Needs a one-time connection by the channel owner; the permission is read-only analytics.
youtube.notConfigured: Not set up: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY are needed.
youtube.channelMismatch: Connected to a different channel than YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID. Connect again.
youtube.connectHint: In Google's account picker, choose the account or brand account that owns the channel.
youtube.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect YouTube Analytics? The permission is revoked at Google and the demographics disappear from the media kit.
youtube.showOn: Demographics are shown in the media kit.
youtube.showOff: Demographics are hidden from the media kit.
youtube.adminOnly: Only admins can connect or change this.
youtube.noData: No data yet. YouTube only returns demographics above its privacy thresholds; the sync tries again daily.

outcomes.invalidState: The connection request expired or didn't match. Start again.
outcomes.missingScope: Google didn't grant the analytics permission. Start again and allow it.
outcomes.noRefreshToken: Google didn't return a lasting authorization. Start again.
outcomes.notOwner: That Google account can't read this channel's analytics. Choose the account that owns the channel.
outcomes.failed: Connecting failed. See the server log.
outcomes.forbidden: Only admins can connect YouTube Analytics.
outcomes.notConfigured: YouTube Analytics isn't set up on the server yet.

games.intro: The games shown under “What I play” on the home page, in this order.
games.adminOnly: Only admins can change the games.
games.empty: No games yet. Add the first one.
games.name: Name
games.blurbHint: One or two sentences, shown under the game name.
games.tagsHint: Comma-separated, up to 6 (e.g. Hourglass PvP, Tucking). Shown as-is in both languages.
games.confirmText: It disappears from the home page right away. This can't be undone.

errors.tagTooLong: Each tag can have at most 30 characters.
errors.forbidden: Only admins can change the games.
errors.failed: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.
errors.tooLarge: The image is larger than 4 MB.
errors.notAnImage: That file isn't a supported image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF).

games.twitchCategoryHint: The cover image comes from Twitch. Leave empty if the game has the same name on Twitch; otherwise enter its exact Twitch name (e.g. “Hunt: Showdown 1896”).
games.noCover: No cover found on Twitch – check the Twitch category name.
games.coverHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF, up to 4 MB. Cropped to 3:4.
games.shownOnHome: {name} is shown on the home page
games.hiddenFromHome: {name} is hidden from the home page

schedule.intro: Plan streams that repeat weekly or happen once. Cancel single streams from the upcoming list; they stay listed as cancelled. Times are Vienna time.
schedule.titleHint: Optional. Shown next to the game. Write @name to link a Twitch channel.
schedule.activeHint: Paused streams stay saved but don't appear on the site.

errors.forbidden: You need to be signed in as staff.
errors.failed: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.
errors.weekdayMismatch: That stream doesn't happen on this date.
errors.pastDate: Pick today or a later date.

schedule.upcomingHint: The next four weeks, from the weekly plan and one-time streams.
schedule.noUpcoming: Nothing planned in the next four weeks.
schedule.weeklyHint: These repeat every week. Pause one to hide it without deleting it.
schedule.categoriesHint: Labels like “Dixper enabled”, “Sponsored” or “Drops”, shown on the stream in the schedule.
schedule.noCategoriesYet: No categories yet – add some under Categories below.
schedule.repeatWeeklyHint: Same day and time each week.
schedule.repeatOnceHint: On one date, e.g. a special or moved stream.
schedule.cancelExplain: The stream stays in the schedule, struck through and marked “Cancelled”. You can restore it.
schedule.confirmDeleteSlotTitle: Delete the weekly stream on {day} at {time}?
schedule.confirmDeleteSlot: Its cancellations are removed too. To skip a single week, cancel that stream instead.
schedule.confirmDeleteOnce: Delete this one-time stream for good? To keep it listed as cancelled, cancel it instead.
schedule.confirmDeleteCategory: It's removed from every stream that uses it.
schedule.twitchSearchHint: Picks the game for this stream only, without adding it to the Games section.
schedule.twitchSearchFailed: Twitch search failed. Try again in a moment.
schedule.twitchPickedHint: Twitch category, not in the Games section.

discord.heading: Discord
discord.hint: Posts the week as a message with an image to a Discord channel and keeps that message up to date.
discord.adminOnly: Only admins can change the Discord connection. Staff can update the message.
discord.notReady: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY isn't set, so the webhook can't be stored securely.
discord.webhookHint: In Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL. It's stored encrypted and never shown again.
discord.autoUpdateHint: After every schedule change, and when a day is over (checked every 5 minutes).
discord.postNewHint: Posts a fresh message (e.g. for a new week); the old one is no longer updated.
discord.confirmDisconnect: The message stays in Discord but won't be updated any more. To post again, paste a webhook URL.

errors.invalidUrl: That isn't a Discord webhook URL.
errors.invalidWebhook: Discord doesn't know this webhook (deleted or reset?). Paste a new URL.
errors.rateLimited: Discord is rate-limiting. Try again in a minute.
errors.tooLarge: The image is too large for Discord.
errors.cantDecrypt: The stored webhook can't be read (the encryption key changed). Paste the URL again.
errors.messageGone: The message was deleted in Discord.
errors.failed: Talking to Discord failed. Try again in a moment.

inquiries.intro: Sponsor inquiries sent through the media kit form. Personal data: done and spam inquiries are deleted automatically 12 months after their last change.

legal.intro: The legal notice (Impressum) is built from the operator details below; the privacy policy is your text. Nothing is public until you switch on “Publish”, and publishing is blocked while details are missing or a TODO: marker from the draft is left.
legal.adminOnly: Only admins can change the legal pages.
legal.operatorHint: Shown in the legal notice and as the controller in the privacy policy. Austrian law requires your name, a postal address and an email address.
legal.imprintHint: Optional Markdown shown under the details, e.g. the basic direction of the website (“grundlegende Richtung”) under § 25 MedienG.
legal.privacyHint: Markdown: ## for headings, - for lists, [text](https://…) for links. HTML is not rendered. Replace every TODO: in the draft before publishing.
legal.todosLeft: {count, plural, one {# TODO: left in the privacy policy} other {# TODO: left in the privacy policy}}
legal.published: Publish the legal notice and privacy policy
legal.publishedHint: Adds the footer links and the privacy link at the inquiry form.

Inquiry.heading: Work with me
Inquiry.intro: Tell me about your brand and what you have in mind. I read every inquiry and answer by email, usually within a few days.
Inquiry.messageHint: What would you like to do together? Timeframe, product, format.
Inquiry.privacy: I only use your details to answer this inquiry. They're stored for at most 12 months after it's closed and never shared. Write to me any time to have them deleted.
Inquiry.successText: I'll get back to you by email soon.

errors.rateLimited: Too many inquiries from your connection. Please try again in an hour.
errors.captcha: The human check failed or expired. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: The form is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.failed: Couldn't send. Please try again in a moment.
